### What Does Your Tongue Reveal About Your Heart?
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-june-21-2020.html
Passage: Matthew 12:34
Points:
- A person's speech directly exposes the condition of their inner heart.
- Negative speech patterns, such as harsh or critical words, reflect underlying anger and insecurity.
- True change cannot happen through willpower alone but requires the power of the Holy Spirit.
- Experiencing and resting in God's love heals past pain and produces patient, kind speech.

### Every Careless Word You Speak
Author: Paul Carter
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/ad-fontes/every-careless-word-you-speak/
Passage: Matthew 12:36-37
Points:
- Jesus warns that people will be held accountable for every careless word they speak.
- The term "careless" refers to idle, useless, or thoughtless words spoken without filter.
- Off-the-cuff remarks and impulsive reactions reveal a person's true inner character.
- Trying harder to filter or edit speech cannot solve the core issue.
- The only real solution is the deep, ongoing Gospel work of transforming the heart.
